rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.02, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=15, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-11 PRIOR+DC SYNERGY: add prior back (init_t up) at the winning n_cg=15, breast-native wavelet CONSTRAINED, val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: n_cg sweep at init_t0.005: n_cg5->RMSE5.94e-3(hr0), n_cg15->4.85e-3(hr0.0695 BEST), n_cg25->4.99e-3(hr0.043). Interior n_cg optimum ~15; over-converged CG amplifies 128-view LSQ noise. (2) FAILURE MODE: at n_cg25 the CG solves the unregularized LSQ too exactly -> sparse-system noise re-enters. FIX per iter-10 falsifier: let the wavelet prior regularize that noise by embedding the FBP at a slightly higher flow-time. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_init_t 0.005 -> 0.02 (re-introduce light wavelet-prior denoising), n_cg=15 fixed. (4) HYPOTHESIS: init_t=0.02 gives the wavelet prior enough influence to suppress the CG-DC LSQ streak-noise while DC still pins the data -> RMSE drops below iter-9 4.85e-3, hr>0.0695 (genuine prior+DC synergy, the whole point of the constrained wavelet variant). FALSIFIER: if RMSE rises (>4.85e-3), the prior at 0.02 injects more error than it removes -> the optimum is minimal-prior (init_t~0.005) and hr~0.07 is the ceiling; sweep init_t between 0.005-0.02 to localize. (5) BUDGET ~2min. (6) iter-12 on landing.
